turns.text: Hm. It's stew. Eat it or don't.

turns.speaker: lux
turns.text: Of course, one is expected to find sustenance in monotony, but even I have my limits.

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: If you want variety, go find a berry bush and starve.

turns.text: I think, well, maybe that dog is just... startled by the light?

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so he's totally fine, he just likes to say hi to people...

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I suppose that's... well, probably better than him being aggressive.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: He's like, super friendly, I promise, he just wants to be everyone's best friend!

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Pip, do not sit there all day. Help Tuk with the brush.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I'm totally helping, I'm just like, waiting for the calf to stop moving...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Hold the leg still, Pip. The calf needs the brush.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: I've got it, I'm holding it, see? It's staying totally still now.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Loosen your grip on the rifle, Pip. You are squeezing too hard.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I'm trying, but it's like, totally hard to hold it steady without shaking...

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Relax your hands. If you squeeze like that, you will pull the shot.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: I'll try to relax, but it's like my hands just won't listen to me.

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Hm. Back's gone again. Get the rice moved.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so that's like, totally bad, Nate, do you need me to get the medkit or something...?

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Just move the rice, Pip. I don't need a kit.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: You're totally acting like you're fine but you're literally on the floor!

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I totally just sliced my hand on the wire, it's like, fine though...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Tuk will fix that hand before it gets red and angry.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: It's totally fine, I just need a bandage or something so it doesn't get all gross.

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Tuk will get the bandage. Stay still.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, maybe if you'd just take the medicine, the bleeding would, um, stop more easily?

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Negative. I do not need medicine for this.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: It's not about needing it, it's just... the blood loss is still quite high.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: It is under control. Just finish the stitches.
